about.title: About me
about.contentIntro: Hi, I'm <name>AarynLu</name>, a software engineer becoming indie hacker.
about.contentFocus: I'm interested in AI agents, developer tools, automation, and AI-native product building. Instead of handwriting every line of code, I care more about how to harness AI: defining problems, designing workflows, orchestrating tools, viewing generative content with critical thinking, and turning ideas into systems that actually work.
about.contentBelief: I believe that in the age of AI, the barrier to building products is being redefined. The value of a software engineer is no longer just about writing code, but about understanding problems, designing engineering workflows and systems, judging results, and continuously bringing ideas into reality.
about.contentClosing: This is the way I'm exploring what one person can create.
